description: Cite Caddy gives full read/write access to a Zotero library — search, add, tag, update, delete, and move items; create, rename, and delete collections; upload/download attachments and read their extracted full text; read and write item notes; manage tags, trash, and saved searches library-wide; and look up Zotero's own item-type/field schema.

tool_signatures.name: add_tags
tool_signatures.description: Add one or more tags to an item, keeping its existing tags. Safe, key-preserving. version: the item's current version (see update_item).

tool_signatures.name: add_to_collection
tool_signatures.description: File an item into a collection, in addition to any it's already in. Safe, key-preserving reorganization within the same library -- prefer this over move_item_to_different_library whenever the goal is just organizing, not actually relocating to a different library. version: the item's current version (see update_item).

tool_signatures.name: create_collection
tool_signatures.description: Create a new collection, optionally nested under parent_key. Safe.

tool_signatures.name: create_item
tool_signatures.description: Add a new item to the library. Safe: creates a brand-new key, never touches an existing one.

tool_signatures.name: create_note
tool_signatures.description: Add a new note as a child of an existing item (e.g. a research note attached to a journalArticle). Safe: creates a brand-new note item with its own key; never touches the parent item's own fields or version.

tool_signatures.name: create_saved_search
tool_signatures.description: Create a new saved search. Safe: creates a brand-new key, never touches an existing one.

tool_signatures.name: delete_collection
tool_signatures.description: DESTRUCTIVE -- permanently deletes the collection. Matches Zotero's own "Delete Collection" behavior: any sub-collections nested under it are deleted too, cascading -- but items filed in it (or in a deleted sub-collection) are NOT deleted from the library, only unfiled from that collection.

tool_signatures.name: delete_item_permanently
tool_signatures.description: DESTRUCTIVE -- permanently deletes the item from its library. Cannot be undone through this server.

tool_signatures.name: delete_saved_search
tool_signatures.description: DESTRUCTIVE, but low-risk -- permanently deletes this saved search definition. Unlike delete_item_permanently/delete_collection, this doesn't touch any items or their citations -- a saved search is just a stored filter, not a container. idempotency_key: optional opaque string; if a call with this exact key already completed, that same outcome is replayed instead of running against Zotero again -- see delete_item_permanently's docstring for the full explanation.

tool_signatures.name: delete_tag
tool_signatures.description: DESTRUCTIVE -- permanently removes this tag from every item in the library that carries it (not one item -- see remove_tags for that). Cannot be undone through this server.

tool_signatures.name: download_attachment
tool_signatures.description: Download an attachment's file content (see list_attachments for keys). Read-only. Returns `content_base64` -- this server runs remotely, so raw bytes travel as a base64 string rather than a local file path; decode it to reconstruct the file.

tool_signatures.name: export_bibliography
tool_signatures.description: Generate formatted bibliography/citation entries or portable export data for one or more items. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: get_fulltext
tool_signatures.description: Fetch Zotero's extracted full-text content and indexing progress for an attachment (see list_attachments for keys). Only meaningful for attachments Zotero has indexed -- PDFs/text files with extracted text -- not e.g. images; raises an error if there's no indexed full text for this key. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: get_item
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one item by key. Read-only. Use this to get an item's current `version` right before a mutating call, if you don't already have a fresh one from search_items. `creators` is a list of {creatorType, firstName, lastName} (or {creatorType, name} for single-field/ institutional creators) entries -- see search_items' docstring.

tool_signatures.name: list_attachments
tool_signatures.description: List the file attachments (PDFs, snapshots, etc.) filed under an item -- not its notes. Read-only. Each result's `key` can be passed to download_attachment or get_fulltext.

tool_signatures.name: list_collections
tool_signatures.description: List all collections in the library (key, name, parent_collection). Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: list_creator_fields
tool_signatures.description: List the name-shape fields Zotero recognizes on a `creators` entry (e.g. "firstName", "lastName", "name") -- for building creators entries in create_item/update_item's `creators` argument. Distinct from list_item_creator_types, which lists creatorType *roles* (author, editor, ...) rather than name fields. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: list_groups
tool_signatures.description: List the Zotero groups the configured API key's user account belongs to. Read-only. Each result's `id` can be passed as target_library_id (with target_library_type="group") to move_item_to_different_library, if the group you want isn't this server's own configured library.

tool_signatures.name: list_item_creator_types
tool_signatures.description: List the valid `creatorType` values (e.g. "author", "editor") for one item type -- for create_item/update_item's `creators` entries, e.g. {"creatorType": "author", ...}. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: list_item_fields
tool_signatures.description: List every bibliographic field Zotero recognizes across all item types combined -- not which fields are valid for one specific type (see list_item_type_fields for that, which is what create_item actually needs). Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: list_item_type_fields
tool_signatures.description: List the bibliographic fields valid for one item type -- only these keys are valid in create_item/update_item's `fields` argument for this item_type; anything else raises a validation error. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: list_item_types
tool_signatures.description: List every Zotero item type (e.g. "book", "journalArticle", "webpage") -- valid values for create_item's item_type argument. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: list_notes
tool_signatures.description: List the notes filed under an item -- not its file attachments (see list_attachments for those). Read-only. Each result includes full note content and `version` -- pass both to update_note.

tool_signatures.name: list_saved_searches
tool_signatures.description: List saved searches -- Zotero's own stored search definitions (visible in the desktop app's left-hand pane), not ad-hoc calls to search_items. Read-only. Each result's `key` can be passed to delete_saved_search.

tool_signatures.name: list_tags
tool_signatures.description: List distinct tags used anywhere in the library -- not one item's tags (see search_items/get_item for those). Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: list_trash
tool_signatures.description: List items currently in the trash -- soft-deleted (e.g. via the Zotero desktop app's "Move to Trash", or trash_item), but not yet permanently gone. Read-only. Each result's `key`/`version` can be passed to restore_from_trash. limit/start: pagination (default limit 25). `creators` shape matches search_items/get_item.

tool_signatures.name: move_item_to_different_library
tool_signatures.description: DESTRUCTIVE -- moves an item to a different Zotero library (e.g. from this user library into a group library, or vice versa). Zotero has no native cross-library move: this recreates the item in the target library under a BRAND-NEW key, then deletes the original.

tool_signatures.name: remove_from_collection
tool_signatures.description: Remove an item from one collection; it stays in the library and any other collections it's filed under. Safe, key-preserving. version: the item's current version (see update_item).

tool_signatures.name: remove_tags
tool_signatures.description: Remove one or more tags from an item; other tags are kept. Safe, key-preserving. version: the item's current version (see update_item).

tool_signatures.name: rename_tag
tool_signatures.description: Rename a tag across every item in the library that carries it (not just one item -- see add_tags/remove_tags/set_tags for single-item edits). Zotero has no native tag-rename: this adds new_tag and removes old_tag on each affected item individually, merging with each item's existing tags.

tool_signatures.name: restore_from_trash
tool_signatures.description: Remove an item from the trash, restoring it to the library. Safe, key-preserving. version: the item's current version (from list_trash).

tool_signatures.name: search_items
tool_signatures.description: Search the Zotero library. Read-only.

tool_signatures.name: set_tags
tool_signatures.description: Replace ALL of an item's tags with exactly this list (not merged -- use add_tags/remove_tags to change tags incrementally instead). Safe, key-preserving. version: the item's current version (see update_item).

tool_signatures.name: trash_item
tool_signatures.description: Move an item to the trash (soft delete). Unlike delete_item_permanently, this is reversible via restore_from_trash -- prefer it whenever a delete might need to be undone. Safe, key-preserving: the item's key is unchanged, so a Word citation referencing it keeps resolving unless/until it's later permanently deleted (e.g. via delete_item_permanently, or "Empty Trash" in the Zotero desktop app).

tool_signatures.name: update_collection
tool_signatures.description: Rename and/or move (reparent) a collection, in place. Safe: the collection's key is unchanged, so items filed in it and any sub-collections stay put.

tool_signatures.name: update_item
tool_signatures.description: Edit bibliographic fields (title, date, DOI, url, abstractNote, publicationTitle, creators, etc.) on an existing item, in place. Safe: the item's key is unchanged, so any Word citation referencing it keeps working. `creators` (if included) replaces the whole author/editor list -- e.g. [{"creatorType": "author", "firstName": "Ada", "lastName": "Lovelace"}], not a merge into the existing list.

tool_signatures.name: update_note
tool_signatures.description: Edit a note's content, in place. Safe, key-preserving. version: the note's current version (from list_notes).

tool_signatures.name: update_publication_status
tool_signatures.description: Update an item in place to reflect that a preprint has been formally published -- e.g. an arXiv preprint that just received a journal DOI. Same key-preserving patch as update_item (Word citations keep working) -- prefer this or update_item over deleting and recreating the item whenever a preprint's status changes.

tool_signatures.name: upload_attachment
tool_signatures.description: Upload a new file attachment as a child of an existing item (e.g. attach a PDF to a journalArticle item). Safe: creates a brand-new attachment item with its own key; never touches the parent item's own fields or version.
